tournaments.name: Twin Talon Challengers Cup
tournaments.purpose:
HOW IT WORKS

- NO TIME LIMITS
- 16 TEAMS COMPETE IN 8 BLIND DRAW MATCHES
- THE 8 WINNING TEAMS COMPETE IN 4 BLIND DRAW MATCHES
- THE 4 WINNERS MOVE ON TO THE SEMI-FINALS ON THE GO-HOME SHOWS OF THAT MONTH
- THE CUP FINALS WILL TAKE PLACE AT THE FOLLOWING PPV (GROUND ZERO IN JAN)
- THE WINNING TEAM WILL BE THE NEW TWIN TALON TAG TEAM CHAMPIONS AND WILL RECEIVE THE CHALLENGERS CUP

tournaments.name: The Wonder Of Worlds Memorial
tournaments.purpose:
The Wonder of Worlds Memorial is an annual OWL tradition created to honor the legacies of Bray Wyatt and Chyna—two unforgettable performers who challenged convention, broke expectations, and changed what a wrestling superstar could be.

Rather than simply recreate the past, the Memorial celebrates that spirit through competition. The Eater of Worlds Classic rewards those capable of surviving a tournament field and standing above their peers, while The Ninth Wonder places men and women together under the same rules, recognizing the kind of boundary-breaking fearlessness that made Chyna unlike anyone before her. Every winner adds their name to a tradition built around individuality, ambition, and the courage to become something wrestling has never seen before.
